prompts.enemyBossSheet: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached 5x5 body sprite atlas into one SALT RAIDER BOSS. Keep exact grid, five direction rows E,SE,S,NE,N, idle+four gait columns, bottom-centre anchors, adult proportions and muted coastal pixel-art family. Same character in every cell. Boss wears a dark weatherproof olive-brown coat over an obvious dark protective vest, a faded ORANGE cloth tied on the upper torso, a conspicuous small keyring at belt and a close-fitting pack. Weathered dark cap, ordinary adult build, no giant body. Clear hard-edged pixel clusters readable after 32x48 export. BODY ONLY without arms below shoulders or hands, no held weapon; runtime supplies arms and shotgun. True alpha transparency. No scenery, shadow, border, text or labels. Exact 25 complete silhouettes in identical scale. Keep 39 logical pixel body height with feet y47 and centre x16.
prompts.enemyCrabSheet: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production transparent sprite atlas, FIVE columns by FIVE rows exactly, 25 complete frames of the same tidal crab for a top-down 2.5D survival game. Rows E (right), SE (down-right), S (front), NE (rear-right), N (back); cols idle then four lateral walking gait phases. Creature has LOW WIDE flattened mottled gray-green salt-crusted shell, several clearly separated short articulated legs and two asymmetrical claws, one larger dark-brown heavy pincer. Animal anatomy, NOT humanoid, no clothes or equipment. Whole crab including legs and claws in every frame. Muted wet-brown/gray-green/bone-white coastal pixel-art with restrained tiny dark yellow joint accents. Big readable pixel clusters and dark outline, adult believable animal, not cute, not illustration. Every frame shares bottom-centre foot anchor, clear gutters only inside equal cells; 32x48 logical export with body about 28px wide and 22px high occupying the bottom of each cell. No dropped legs, no overlaps between cells, no props, labels, text, ground or shadow. Genuine transparent alpha background. Canvas portrait 5 columns x5 rows, directions exact; the animal faces only the specified direction per row.
prompts.enemyDogSheet: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for a top-down 2.5D survival game, exact FIVE columns x FIVE rows, 25 frames of ONE saltback dog. A lean visible-rib adult dog, long believable four-legged canine skeleton, dirty yellow-gray fur, broken old collar, intermittent uneven bone-white salt deposits down spine; lowered alert head, short restrained tail. NOT humanoid, NOT two-legged, no armor, no human clothing. Keep all FOUR legs anatomically correct, all paws and tail inside every cell. Body about 29 logical pixels wide and 24 high, intended 32x48 cell export, use empty transparent space above. No violence, blood, extra objects, captions, borders, grid lines, ground shadows or painted background. Genuine ALPHA transparency throughout empty cells. Exact grid with equal cells, no random facing directions.
